name: Employee
description: Central data model containing employee personal information, contact details, and onboarding status for the employee onboarding system

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the employee

fields.name: firstName
fields.description: Employee's first name

fields.name: lastName
fields.description: Employee's last name

fields.name: email
fields.description: Employee's work email address

fields.name: phoneNumber
fields.description: Employee's primary contact phone number

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Employee's official start date

fields.name: position
fields.description: Employee's job title or position

fields.name: onboardingStatus
fields.description: Current status of employee onboarding process (e.g., pending, in-progress, completed)

name: EquipmentCatalog
description: Master catalog of equipment configurations and standard packages for different roles and departments

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment package

fields.name: packageName
fields.description: Name of the equipment package (e.g., 'Developer Standard', 'Sales Executive')

fields.name: role
fields.description: Target role for this equipment package

fields.name: department
fields.description: Department this package is designed for

fields.name: equipmentItems
fields.description: List of equipment items included in the package with specifications

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether this package is currently available for assignment

fields.name: autoProvision
fields.description: Whether this package should be automatically assigned based on role/department match

constraints.uniquePackage: Combination of packageName, role, and department should be unique

name: Department
description: Store department information and configuration for onboarding workflows

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the department

fields.name: name
fields.description: Department name (e.g., Engineering, Sales, HR)

fields.name: managerId
fields.description: Reference to Employee who manages this department

fields.name: itContactId
fields.description: Reference to Employee who handles IT setup for this department

fields.name: standardEquipmentPackageId
fields.description: Reference to default equipment package from EquipmentCatalog

fields.name: onboardingDurationDays
fields.description: Standard number of days for department onboarding workflow

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Whether department is active and accepting new employees

name: Document
description: Manages employee documents submitted during onboarding with verification status and secure storage references

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who submitted the document

fields.name: documentType
fields.description: Type of document (e.g., ID_PROOF, TAX_FORM, BANK_DETAILS, EMPLOYMENT_VERIFICATION)

fields.name: storageUrl
fields.description: Secure storage location reference or URL for the uploaded document

fields.name: verificationStatus
fields.description: Current verification status (e.g., PENDING, APPROVED, REJECTED)

fields.name: rejectionReason
fields.description: Reason for rejection if document was not approved

fields.name: uploadedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was uploaded

fields.name: verifiedAt
fields.description: Timestamp when the document was verified or rejected

relationships.description: Each document belongs to one employee

name: EquipmentAssignment
description: Tracks IT equipment assigned to employees including assignment dates, equipment details, and return status for asset management

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the equipment assignment

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the equipment

fields.name: equipmentCatalogId
fields.description: Reference to the equipment item from the catalog

fields.name: serialNumber
fields.description: Unique serial number or asset tag of the assigned equipment

fields.name: assignedDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was assigned to the employee

fields.name: returnDate
fields.description: Date when equipment was returned by the employee

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the assignment (assigned, returned, damaged, lost)

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Additional notes about the assignment or equipment condition

relationships.description: Each assignment belongs to one employee
Each assignment references one equipment catalog item

name: Credential
description: Securely manages employee login credentials and access permissions with encrypted storage and expiry tracking

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the credential record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee who owns this credential

fields.name: credentialType
fields.description: Type of credential (e.g., email, VPN, system_access, application)

fields.name: encryptedValue
fields.description: Encrypted credential data stored securely at rest

fields.name: generatedDate
fields.description: Date when the credential was generated

fields.name: expiryDate
fields.description: Date when the credential expires and requires renewal

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Status of credential delivery (e.g., pending, delivered, failed)

fields.name: isActive
fields.description: Indicates whether the credential is currently active

relationships.description: Each credential belongs to one employee

constraints.encryptionRequired: encryptedValue field must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent
constraints.credentialTypeValues: credentialType must be one of: email, vpn, system_access, application
constraints.deliveryStatusValues: deliveryStatus must be one of: pending, delivered, failed

name: TrainingPlan
description: Define and track employee training requirements and completion status

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the training plan

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee assigned to this training plan

fields.name: trainingModules
fields.description: List of training courses and modules required for completion

fields.name: dueDate
fields.description: Target completion date for the training plan

fields.name: completionStatus
fields.description: Current status: not_started, in_progress, completed, overdue

fields.name: completedDate
fields.description: Date when all training requirements were completed

fields.name: approvalStatus
fields.description: Manager approval status: pending, approved, rejected

fields.name: approvedBy
fields.description: Manager ID who approved the training plan

relationships.description: Each training plan is assigned to one employee

name: MentorAssignment
description: Manages mentor-mentee relationships during employee onboarding, tracking assignments, meetings, and feedback sessions

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the mentor assignment

fields.name: menteeId
fields.description: Reference to the new employee being mentored

fields.name: mentorId
fields.description: Reference to the employee serving as mentor

fields.name: assignmentDate
fields.description: Date when the mentor was assigned to the mentee

fields.name: endDate
fields.description: Expected or actual end date of the mentorship period

fields.name: status
fields.description: Current status of the assignment (active, completed, reassigned, cancelled)

fields.name: meetingCount
fields.description: Number of meetings conducted between mentor and mentee

fields.name: lastFeedbackDate
fields.description: Date of the most recent feedback session

relationships.description: Links to the employee being mentored
Links to the employee serving as mentor

businessRules: menteeId and mentorId must reference different employees
assignmentDate cannot be in the future
endDate must be after assignmentDate if specified

name: ReviewSchedule
description: Manages scheduled review meetings for new employees at 30, 60, and 90-day intervals with tracking and feedback storage

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the review schedule

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being reviewed

fields.name: reviewType
fields.description: Type of review: 30-day, 60-day, or 90-day

fields.name: scheduledDate
fields.description: Date and time when the review is scheduled

fields.name: reviewerIds
fields.description: List of participant IDs (manager, mentor, HR) conducting the review

fields.name: status
fields.description: Review status: scheduled, completed, cancelled, or rescheduled

fields.name: feedback
fields.description: Review feedback and notes from participants

fields.name: completedDate
fields.description: Actual date when the review was completed

relationships.description: Links review schedule to the employee being reviewed

name: OnboardingStatus
description: Track overall onboarding progress and workflow stage for each employee

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the onboarding status record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee being onboarded

fields.name: currentStage
fields.description: Current workflow stage (e.g., pre-boarding, orientation, training, integration, completed)

fields.name: completionPercentage
fields.description: Overall completion percentage of onboarding process (0-100)

fields.name: pendingTasksCount
fields.description: Number of outstanding tasks requiring completion

fields.name: milestonesAchieved
fields.description: List of completed milestone identifiers

fields.name: lastUpdated
fields.description: Timestamp of last status update

fields.name: expectedCompletionDate
fields.description: Projected date for onboarding completion

relationships.description: Each onboarding status belongs to one employee

constraints.currentStage: Must be one of: pre-boarding, orientation, training, integration, completed

name: Notification
description: Log and track all automated notifications sent during onboarding process

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the notification record

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee receiving the notification

fields.name: notificationType
fields.description: Type of notification (e.g., welcome_email, equipment_ready, training_reminder, document_pending)

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address where notification was sent

fields.name: sentAt
fields.description: Timestamp when notification was sent

fields.name: deliveryStatus
fields.description: Current delivery status (pending, sent, delivered, failed, bounced)

fields.name: retryCount
fields.description: Number of retry attempts made for failed deliveries

fields.name: deliveredAt
fields.description: Timestamp when delivery was confirmed

name: WorkflowAudit
description: Maintains comprehensive audit trail of all onboarding workflow actions including transitions, approvals, assignments, and system events

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the audit entry

fields.name: employeeId
fields.description: Reference to the employee whose onboarding workflow is being audited

fields.name: actionType
fields.description: Type of workflow action (e.g., STATUS_CHANGE, APPROVAL, REJECTION, ASSIGNMENT, NOTIFICATION_SENT, DOCUMENT_UPLOADED)

fields.name: actionDetails
fields.description: Detailed description of the action taken, including previous and new states

fields.name: performedBy
fields.description: User ID or system identifier that performed the action

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Date and time when the action occurred

fields.name: metadata
fields.description: Additional contextual information in JSON format (e.g., IP address, related entity IDs, comments)

relationships.description: Links audit entry to the employee

indexes.name: idx_employee_timestamp
indexes.description: Optimizes queries for employee audit history chronologically

indexes.name: idx_action_type
indexes.description: Enables efficient filtering by action type

indexes.name: idx_performed_by
indexes.description: Supports queries for actions by specific users
